name: Excelsior representative northwestern outflow
authorship: Hand traced against USDA NAIP aerial imagery acquired 2022-07-19
horizontal_crs: EPSG:32612 with project origin subtracted; x east and z south
geometry_status: Representative authored alignment; the actual drainage has several branches. Steam obscures some of the pool margin. The final point is snapped to the imported Firehole centerline during authoring.
water_level_status: Start pinned to authored Excelsior pool level and end pinned to the shared Firehole water profile. Intermediate level follows a bounded, monotone fit to the DEM.
parameter_status: Illustrative scenario values. The NPS reports more than 4000 US gallons per minute for all Excelsior outflow, not a measured discharge for this individual branch.
future_refinement: Digitize every distributary and measured channel cross-section; partition total flow and solve mass/heat transport before claiming calibrated water behavior.
